input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：在古代，do not combine a time noun with a redundant time expression; “古代” already gives the time setting.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人不知道他们能吃什么植物：人们不知道什么植物能吃，use “人们” for the concrete group of people in this situation; “他们” is unnecessary because the people who may eat the plants are already understood.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 试一试很多种植物：尝一尝很多种植物，“试一试” usually means testing whether something works or fits, while “尝一尝” specifically means tasting food or plants.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：告诉人们哪些植物是安全的，哪些植物是危险的，use “人们” for the group being told, and repeat the noun phrase in the two parallel parts; an adjective after “是” normally takes “的” here.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的男人，follow the first-mention rule by briefly introducing a new character with a name and a noun phrase.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉人们：告诉了人们，use “了” for the completed action of telling people after he has tested the plants.
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 但是不知道为什么，没有办法：人们不知道为什么，也没有办法，“但是” marks contrast, but these two ideas are not contrasting; “也” links two related problems.

items.reason: “古代时候” lacks the required 的, and “在古代” is a correct replacement.
“人” should be “人们” for this concrete group, and the revised wording correctly removes the unnecessary pronoun.
“试一试很多种植物” is acceptable for testing different plants, even though “尝一尝” is also possible in this story.
The original needs “人们” and 的 after the adjectives, and the correction supplies both correctly.
神农 is first introduced here, so a brief identifying noun phrase is required by the teacher's reference rule.
The telling is the completed final action in this sequence, so “告诉了人们” correctly marks it with 了.
“但是” can acceptably introduce the turn from people dying to their not knowing the reason, so it is not necessarily an error.
